mods.name: sdlc-workflow
mods.description: One command: `/wf` (`$wf` under Codex), the single SDLC entry point for Claude Code and Codex from one plugin tree: driving a 10-stage lifecycle from intake through retro, with per-slice artifacts, runtime-truth verification, and PO-confirmed stack fingerprinting. 22 keys: the stages, standalone/drivers (design, probe, simplify, auto, yolo), the task minimal lifecycle (non-code work with observed outcomes), navigation (status, recap), lifecycle (close), and routers (ship-plan, docs, observability). Code review is the `/wf review` key; design is `/wf design`; observability foundation is `/wf observability`; quick/standalone flows are `/wf intake` modes (including the audit defect hunt) plus the `/wf probe` and `/wf simplify` keys.
mods.author: jayte
